description: This file implements functions for sending messages and reactions via Nextcloud Talk, including signature generation, request handling, and error processing.

methods.name: resolveCredentials
methods.description: Resolves and validates the baseUrl and secret for Nextcloud Talk account, throwing errors if missing.

methods.name: normalizeRoomToken
methods.description: Normalizes the room token by stripping prefix and validating presence.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkSendContext
methods.description: Resolves configuration, account, baseUrl, and secret for sending messages.

methods.name: recordNextcloudTalkOutboundActivity
methods.description: Records outbound activity for Nextcloud Talk, handling uninitialized runtime errors.

methods.name: sendMessageNextcloudTalk
methods.description: Sends a message to a Nextcloud Talk room, handling signature, response parsing, and error cases.

methods.name: sendReactionNextcloudTalk
methods.description: Sends a reaction to a message in Nextcloud Talk, including signature and error handling.
